channel.title: Majestic Travels
channel.description: Slow travel stories, solo guides, and field notes by Adrien.

item.title: December in NYC: The Ultimate Holiday Magic Guide
item.description: New York City is at its most magical in December. The entire city transforms into a living holiday card — from the Rockefeller tree to Dyker Heights, with insider tips on how to do it right.

item.title: 4 Nights at Bab Akoul: Private Villas, Late-Night Swims, and the Best Couscous in Marrakech
item.description: We stayed at two Bab Akoul properties outside Marrakech: a private villa with a pool you won't want to leave, and a livelier resort with friendly staff and a 15-year-old cat. Here's what it's really like.

item.title: I Went to Fuerteventura to Escape and Found Myself Again
item.description: Not here for parties or nightlife — just a desperate need to breathe. A story about burnout, surfing, hidden beaches, and the version of yourself buried between stress and boredom.

item.title: The Ultimate 10-Day NYC Guide: A Love Letter to the City That Never Sleeps
item.description: Everything learned from countless NYC trips — hidden gems discovered at dawn, the iconic sights done right, and every lesson from the hard way so you do not have to repeat the mistakes.

item.title: New York City in Summer: A Love Letter to the Greatest City on Earth
item.description: The way golden light bounces off skyscrapers at sunset, the hum of sidewalk chatter mixing with distant jazz, the smell of hot pretzels and sudden rain on pavement. It's alive. It pulses. And if you let it, it'll rewrite your soul.

item.title: My First Time Surfing in Fuerteventura and OTRO MODO Surf School
item.description: Some people go to the Canary Islands for the sun. I went to learn how to surf. What I didn't expect was how much it would teach me about trust — in the ocean, in my body, and in the unknown.

item.title: The Ultimate 5-Day New York City Itinerary for December (Holiday Magic & Hidden Gems)
item.description: Twinkling lights, skating rinks under skyscrapers, and the smell of roasted chestnuts in the air — a 5-day December plan filled with iconic spots, local tips, and hidden gems.
